name: Hard Cider
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated as fermentation converts most FODMAPs to alcohol. However, alcohol can affect gut motility and may worsen SIBO symptoms in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Choose dry varieties over sweet ones which may contain added sugars
Check labels for added high-FODMAP ingredients like honey or apple juice concentrate
Start with smaller servings to assess individual tolerance
Consume with food to minimize digestive irritation
nutritionalHighlights: Provides some B vitamins from yeast
